description: This file contains a series of test cases for the 'git grep' command, specifically testing its behavior when searching binary files and the effects of various options related to binary detection, text conversion, and attributes.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects the enclosed commands to succeed, with a given description.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case that is expected to fail, useful for known issues or platform-specific behavior.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the command within the test fails as expected.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output of the previous command is empty.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or inputs and checks if they are identical.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the current test to clean up or reset state.

methods.name: write_script
methods.description: Creates a script file with the specified content.

methods.name: nul_to_q_textconv
methods.description: A text conversion script used in the test to transform null-separated data to 'Q' characters.

methods.name: nul_to_q
methods.description: A utility for converting null characters to 'Q' characters in test outputs.
